---
title: "Contacts Start Worker qualification"
description: "Build, verify and hand off the Contacts Worker for controlled Cloudflare cutover."
updatedAt: "2026-11-20"
audience: developers
---

Vercel is the Contacts production origin while publication is held in
`tuturuuu.ci.ts`. The Contacts native workflow qualifies a route-free production
artifact for `tuturuuu-contacts`. It has no provider credentials or publish job.
The hold also freezes new Vercel Contacts deployments.

## Routes and ownership

The [staging candidate census](/build/devops/contacts-start-candidate) from
[run 43805055297](https://github.com/tutur3u/platform/actions/runs/43805055297)
records 40 App Router pages, 87 API routes, two Web rewrites, a Web API fallback,
a workspace redirect, a static asset and the candidate probe. The native
registries cover the app's current pages and route handlers and are checked
against the source tree in CI.

Contacts serves tutoring, student and group reports, periodic reports, and local
feedback and auth handlers on both the subdomain and the `/contacts` mount. Web
owns workspace invitations, permission settings, workspace billing, and the
contact billing API at `/api/v1/workspaces/[wsId]/users/[userId]/billing`. The
Contacts router retains the method-specific topic announcement split in its
proxy. Contact billing and account-link APIs follow their existing Web release
process.

The apex mount consumes the central session with request-local authorization.
The bridge limits mounted cookies to the locale and shared access identity,
strips provider refresh tokens, and scopes locale writes to `/contacts`. App
session mint and refresh endpoints return 409 on the mount. The native runtime
keeps build identity behind the existing Contacts API guard.

## Build and artifact

The `Contacts Cloudflare Source` workflow stamps and builds the exact checkout
with the production public Supabase URL and publishable key. It checks the
route registries, app tests, native types and formatting, validates the emitted
configuration, and executes the same dual-host workerd suite on the build and
a fresh restore. Take `contacts-native-<40-character SHA>` only from a run whose
restore job passed. Verify the archive digest and the config and file hashes
against its sealed receipt before handing it to the routing owner.

The emitted config owns the worker-first `ASSETS` binding. Both public preview
host types are disabled. At runtime, configure `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and
`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` for the same project as the build and
supply `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` and `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET` through the
Worker secret store. Verify they match the intended tier and coordinate the
app-session signing key with the issuer. Provide the existing proxy rate-limit
store through `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` and `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN`.
The route table and central API
origin come from the sealed production profile. The Worker has no scheduled
triggers, queues, storage bindings or app-origin retry loop.

## Signed-in acceptance plan

Use the fleet's disposable Contacts identity and an isolated workspace with
tutoring, reports and billing read access. Run the checks against an admitted
native staging target before cutover and repeat them immediately after the
flip on the subdomain and apex mount. Use a second member without the relevant
workspace permissions as a negative control. Capture the source SHA and
`x-tuturuuu-runtime: native` from the admitted deployment.

| Surface | Check |
| --- | --- |
| Session | Sign in through Web, reload a deep link, check session refresh and the required MFA path. On the apex, reuse the Web session and inspect responses for app-session or Supabase cookie writes. Read the exact SHA from the guarded `/api/build-info`. |
| Locale | Open each primary page in EN and VI, reload it, and verify titles, navigation and browser hydration. Explicit locale paths retain the query on the canonical redirect. |
| Tutoring | Open `/[wsId]/users/tutoring`, load the seeded sessions, open the fixture session and verify permission-gated controls. Confirm a member without tutoring access cannot read the same workspace data. |
| Billing | Open the fixture contact's Billing & Growth tab in `/[wsId]/users/database/[userId]`. Check the Web-owned read through both ingress paths and the redirect from `/[wsId]/billing` to the Web billing page. |
| Reports | Open `/[wsId]/users/reports`, a seeded report detail and `/[wsId]/reports`. Compare the report, status and preview with the fixture baseline. Verify that unauthorized reads fail. |

Use seeded reads and previews during cutover smoke. Keep credentials, raw
cookies and customer identifiers out of the evidence. Record host, locale,
source, route, request status and outcome in the private release receipt signed
by the fleet operator. Feature writes with external effects require a separate
disposable acceptance run.

## Rollback

Before routing changes, record the live Vercel deployment ID and source SHA,
the exact subdomain route and DNS/TLS settings, and the current Gateway mount
mapping. Confirm the retained Vercel target still answers. Prepare one
operator action to restore that captured routing and verify that it restores
both ingress paths to their pre-cutover owners. Keep the prior deployment through
one release cycle. During the 30–60 minute watch, roll back immediately on a
failed smoke check, authentication loop, or regression in errors or latency.
See the [native migration runbook](/build/devops/native-start-migration#rollback).
